obligations.note: purge_due in apps/baseline-payments/payments/retention.py skips every closed payee with category tax_authority, so that NPI is never purged after the approved retention period. Legal hold is still honored, but the category skip is not a legal hold, and no approved RET-1 exception covers it. The registered control test is only a sample (test_sampled_purge_respects_hold) and does not establish that every closed payee is purged.

PR-1270 names ticket CHG-25709, which Erik Brandt (change_manager) approved on 2026-10-09 before review. The ticket component payments.retention matches the only touched path, apps/baseline-payments/payments/retention.py.
Mara Costa approved a code_review on the head commit. She has the change_approver role for payments and is not the author, Linh Nguyen.
The change is a single commit, be74efadeacdf5ef95a56062ff336a12b8c20f47, and the code_review approval names that commit.

records/ci/run.json records a successful payments suite on the head commit, and the JUnit report shows 172 tests, 0 failures, 0 errors, and 0 skipped, including the registered RET-1 test test_sampled_purge_respects_hold. A passing sample test does not satisfy RET-1 itself.
retention.py is component payments.retention and is not marked security_sensitive, so a security_review approval is not required.
The only changed path is application code, not a protected controls, control-test, or CI path, so a control_owner approval is not required.
The change is not an emergency: change.json sets emergency to false and ticket CHG-25709 is type standard, so no post-implementation review is due.

The tax-authority purge skip is a deviation from RET-1. The exception register has no approved, unexpired exception scoped to RET-1 and payments.retention with a compensating control (EXC-0141 is SES-1 and expired 2026-09-15; the other entries are other obligations).
No acceptance-ledger entry covers apps/baseline-payments/payments/retention.py, so this edit does not lapse prior evidence for another obligation.

summary: The change permanently exempts closed tax-authority payees from NPI disposal in purge_due. RET-1 requires closed payee NPI to be purged after the approved retention period unless a legal hold applies, and the register contains no valid exception for this deviation. Change-ticket, independent approval, commit coverage, CI on the head commit, and the inapplicable security, control-owner, and emergency rules are in order, but the product deviation is not. The change is rejected.
